objective: TA lines need "-x" appended to their value.
TB lines need "-y" appended to their value.
TC lines need their value shouted (uppercased).
TE lines need their value's first character replaced with Q.
TH lines need "_end" appended to their value.
TI lines need their value un-shouted (lowercased).
TJ lines need their value's first character removed entirely.
TK lines need a question mark appended to their value.
TM lines need "_m" appended to their value.
TN lines need "_n" appended to their value.
TO lines need their value's first character replaced with Z.
TP lines need "_p" appended to their value.
Clear the tag from every line once its fix is applied, wherever that tag appears.
